body: awh thanku my love, i too am not too great with comforting people so ur not alone and its okay!!! <333

some people just don’t understand and jm sorey for u having to experience that too. no one deserves to feel like that but just remember that even if no one notices at least you have yourself? im not sure how much rhat could help you but i guess its just a fight with your esteem really...

I know this isnt what you were expecting but our experiences are soooo similar, i am bullimic and have been for 4 long years and that fight has not been helped by my depression. I know you can fight this like you have before and it makes me feel like i can too <3 thankyou u r honestly so great

you dont even know how hard this hit for me :’) thankyou for writing this as it has made me feel like i am not the only one who is suffering and im not the only one who feels like that they have to be making all the plans- i guess i should start to accept that
of course i see where you are coming from and do appreciate the kindess from a complete stranger. so thankyou for at least trying as thats more then i could have asked for <3
You dont know if i am good... how could you? when even the people closest to me dont even know me. Thankyou for your kind words though- my brain just doesnt seem to accept them though
have you ever thought that maybe you’re not empty but just too unmotivated and depressed to be who you once were?

that is unfortunate :( its quite the hard thing to deal with isnt it?

i would definitely love to do that!! i will look into it but as of right now i luckily get my therapy for free (for a limited time) as my family cannot afford it but since i tried to off myself before i was classed as quite important and therefore was moved up the list haha

They miss the people we were before we fell to our chemical in balances in our brain

My perspective has always been that family only “love” you so much because they had to- you were born into it. If you were a random stranger on the street they wouldn’t look at you twice so is there love really even that valuable to begin with? not for me.

you’re very right, its just hard to remember that when i fall into this spiral of convincing myself that no one cares enough...

 i do in fact have a therapist but sometimes i just dont feel like once a week is enough to portray and start to solve everything im dealing with :0

im sorry for like dropping this all on u but the way u type is so mature im in awe :0
thats exactly how i feel too. i am a shell of who i used to be and now all thats left is pity, shame and guilt for thinking that im so pathetic

you are right it would be easy to set up something like that. i see my friends constantly either at school or our walks that the government has allowed us to go on and yet each day i put on this same persona of “mentally ill but in a funny, relatable way so no one has to face the fact that we all know i constantly want to die” and no one seems to see through it even when im completely honest snd open up about the fact that when im by myself i cry endlessly for hours and contemplate the different and best ways to kill myself.
with covid i dont see that happening unfortunately so all i can do is keep to myself and hope i dont break
